entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: D'you see that ad in the train?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The media's gonna show up at school[n]again.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It said the media's gonna come to our[n]school again.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The media's gonna come to our school.[n]At least be a little interested in it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: "Cover-up by faculty and principal of[n]Shujin Academy, where the Phantom[n]Thieves first appeared."

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's been a huge deal already.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I wonder what's gonna happen to[n]the principal now.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Anyways, we made the right choice goin'[n]after big targets! Everywhere I go,[n]people're talkin' about us!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That girl just now... Don't you think[n]she was fine?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves are on fire right[n]now, so I wonder if I got a chance if I[n]asked her out?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It sucks that I can't just say I'm actually[n]a phantom thief to anybody.
